title: Sequential projects should only show first available task
description:
## Problem
In sequential projects, all tasks currently show as available. In real OmniFocus, sequential projects only make the first uncompleted task available.

## Expected Behavior
- Sequential projects: only first uncompleted task is 'available'
- Parallel projects: all uncompleted tasks are 'available'
- Single actions: task is always available
- 'Available' filter should respect this logic

## Acceptance Criteria
- Sequential project shows only first task as available
- Completing a task in sequential project makes next one available
- Parallel projects show all tasks as available
- Available filter correctly filters based on project type
close_reason: Sequential project filtering was already implemented in the perspectives service. Verified that: 1) Only first task shows for sequential projects 2) Completing a task makes the next one available 3) Parallel projects show all tasks. Added comprehensive tests.

title: Record changes in ActionsService with actor tracking
description:
## Problem

## Solution
- Modify ActionsService methods to log changes to ChangeLog table
- Determine actor from auth context:

  - JWT auth → 'fred'
  - System operations → 'system'
- Log on: create, update, delete, complete, uncomplete, drop
- Include old/new values in changes JSON

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All action mutations logged to ChangeLog
- [ ] Actor correctly determined from auth
- [ ] Changes include field-level diffs
- [ ] Works for bulk operations too

- Can drill into nested projects

- Folders are expandable/collapsible
- Selecting a folder shows its projects
- Selecting a project shows its tasks
- Visual hierarchy with proper indentation

title: Task dependencies/blocking system
description:
## Problem
No way to mark tasks as blocked by other tasks. This is a core OmniFocus feature for sequential workflows.

## Expected Behavior
- Tasks can be blocked by other tasks
- Blocked tasks show visual indicator
- When blocking task completes, blocked task becomes available
- UI to select blocking tasks

## Acceptance Criteria
- Database model for action dependencies
- API support for blockedBy field
- BlockingPicker component
- Integration in TaskDetailPanel
- Visual indicators for blocked tasks
close_reason: Full stack implementation: ActionDependency junction table, API support for blockedBy, BlockingPicker component with TDD (6 tests), integrated in TaskDetailPanel with visual indicators.

title: Project detail view - clicking a project should show its tasks
description:
## Problem
In All Projects view, clicking a project row opens 'Focused On' mode but shows 'No Actions Yet' even though the project has 27 tasks.

## Current UX
- Arrow icon (>) → Opens focused inbox, shows no tasks  
- Flash icon → Opens edit project modal

## Required Changes
1. **Click on project row** → Navigate to a project detail view that shows all tasks inside
2. **Replace arrow with settings/gear icon** → Opens edit project modal
3. **Keep flash icon for flagging**

## Project Detail View Requirements
- Show project name as header
- List all tasks/actions in the project
- Allow checking off tasks
- Allow clicking to open task details
- Allow adding new tasks
- Back button to return to All Projects

This is NOT focus mode - just a simple drill-down view to see and manage tasks within a project.

title: Support infinite task nesting (sub-sub-sub-tasks)
description:
## Problem
Currently cannot create nested tasks within tasks (sub-tasks of sub-tasks). In real OmniFocus, tasks and projects are technically the same entity - the only difference is projects don't have a parent. You can nest tasks infinitely.

## Expected Behavior
- Any task can contain child tasks (becoming a sub-project)
- Tasks should be nestable to any depth
- Projects and tasks share the same data model (just projects have no parent)
- UI should show hierarchy with proper indentation

## Acceptance Criteria
- Can create tasks inside any task (not just at project level)
- Unlimited nesting depth supported
- Visual indentation shows hierarchy
- Collapsible task groups
close_reason: Added 'Add Subtask' option to context menu. The data model already supported infinite nesting via parentId. Created tests for flattening logic and subtask menu item.

- Can outdent tasks by dragging left
- Can drop task onto another to create subtask
- Can drag projects between folders
- Clear visual indicator of drop target
- Works with nested hierarchies

title: Add ChangeLog table and Prisma migration
description:
## Problem
Rocky needs to poll for changes without downloading everything.

## Solution
Add ChangeLog model to Prisma schema:

```prisma
model ChangeLog {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  entityType  String   // 'action', 'project', 'tag', 'folder'
  entityId    String
  action      String   // 'create', 'update', 'delete', 'complete', 'uncomplete'
  actor       String   // 'fred', 'rocky', 'system'
  changes     Json?    // { field: { old, new } }
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([actor])
  @@index([entityType])
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ChangeLog model added to schema.prisma
- [ ] Migration created and applied
- [ ] Indexes on createdAt, actor, entityType

title: Implement 'Available' filter logic
description:
## Problem
OmniFocus has sophisticated logic for determining which tasks are 'available' vs just 'remaining'. Need to implement this.

## Available Logic (from real OmniFocus)
A task is available when ALL of these are true:
1. Task is not completed or dropped
2. Defer date has passed (or no defer date)
3. If in sequential project: task is first remaining task
4. Parent task/project is not blocked or on hold
5. No blocking dependencies

## Expected Behavior
- 'Available' filter shows only truly actionable tasks
- 'Remaining' shows all incomplete (available or not)
- Sequential project logic is respected
- Defer dates are respected
- Project status (active/on hold/blocked) is respected

## Acceptance Criteria
- Available filter implemented correctly
- Respects sequential/parallel project types
- Respects defer dates
- Respects project status
- UI clearly shows available vs remaining tasks
close_reason: Implemented 'Available' perspective with comprehensive filtering: 1) Defer date filtering (future dates hidden) 2) Project status filtering (on-hold projects hidden) 3) Sequential project logic (only first task available). Added tests for all behaviors.

title: Add GET /api/changelog endpoint
description:
## Problem
Rocky needs an API to query changes since last poll.

## Solution
Create ChangeLog module with controller and service:

GET /api/changelog
Query params:
- since: ISO timestamp (required)
- actor: 'fred' | 'rocky' | 'all' (default: 'all')
- entityType: 'action' | 'project' | 'tag' | 'folder' (optional)
- limit: number (default: 100, max: 500)

Response:
```json
{
  "changes": [{
    "id": "...",
    "entityType": "action",
    "entityId": "...",
    "action": "complete",
    "actor": "fred",
    "changes": { "status": { "old": "active", "new": "completed" } },
    "createdAt": "..."
  }],
  "cursor": "..."
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] GET /api/changelog endpoint works
- [ ] Filters by since, actor, entityType
- [ ] Returns cursor for pagination
- [ ] Proper auth guard
